{{Quote|It's Slide Paramita, in his modified Pizer-Errol ''Stinger''. Very sharp.|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fode Annodue]], a [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] race announcer, commenting on a Pizer-Errol Podracer|audio=Fode-SlideParamita.flac|<ref name="E1R" />}}
'''Pizer-Errol''' was a company that designed [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]], including the [[Stinger 627 S|''Stinger'' 627 S]], a Podracer notable for its maneuverability and acceleration, though it was lacking in overall speed.<ref name="E1R" /> During [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The racing season presented in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' must have taken place during this year due to the appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which correspond to ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref> the [[Ciasi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Slide Paramita]] favored the Stinger and owned a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] one that he was known to modify. The vehicle was notably fragile, and could not sustain the same kind of damage larger pods could.<ref name="E1R" /> However, that did not stop Paramita from occasionally using his ''Stinger'' as a weapon out of desperation.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Pizer-Errol was first mentioned<ref name="E1R" /> in the [[1999]]<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ign.com/games/star-wars-episode-i-racer|text=Star Wars: Episode I: Racer - Nintendo 64 - IGN|work=[http://www.ign.com IGN]|archivedate=20161118045154}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', where it acted as the manufacturer for the ''Stinger'' 627 S Podracer.<ref name="E1R" />
